subject.title: feat(gateway): durable cloud worker environments, provider SDK contract, and lifecycle RPCs

question: Should OpenClaw freeze the proposed cloudWorkers configuration, WorkerProvider plugin SDK, durable shared-state model, and lifecycle RPCs as the permanent first cloud-workers milestone?
rationale: These are new public, persisted, upgrade-sensitive, and security-sensitive contracts. The protected maintainer label and canonical issue's product/security gates require an explicit human decision even after the patch defects and proof gap are resolved.

options.title: Approve after gates
options.body: Accept the foundation after the startup, secret-contract, upgrade, and live-proof requirements are satisfied.

options.title: Narrow the milestone
options.body: Keep the cloud-workers direction but defer public SDK/protocol/config contracts until a smaller internal experiment proves their shape.

options.title: Pause the series
options.body: Defer this PR until maintainers reconfirm the broader remote-execution architecture and security model.

recommendation.title: Approve after gates
recommendation.body: Accept the foundation after the startup, secret-contract, upgrade, and live-proof requirements are satisfied.

likelyOwner.reason: The current assignee authored both the design and implementation and has the clearest context to own the permanent contract decision.
